name: Ivana Horvat
bio:
Ivana Horvat's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent helping her father, a local mechanic, tinker with engines. This early exposure ignited a passion for the technical aspects of racing, eventually leading her to pursue a career in logistics. Prior to joining Kosmic Kart, Ivana honed her skills at a regional karting series, managing the transport and maintenance of the team's equipment.

Ivana is known for her meticulous approach to logistics. She leaves no stone unturned when planning the movement of equipment and personnel, ensuring that everything arrives on time and in perfect condition. She believes in fostering strong relationships with suppliers and transport companies to navigate the complexities of international racing. Her commitment to teamwork and reliability makes her an invaluable asset to Kosmic Kart. 

What sets Ivana apart is her uncanny ability to anticipate potential logistical challenges before they arise. Her proactive problem-solving skills have saved the team from numerous delays and disruptions, earning her the nickname 'The Oracle' among her colleagues.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Ivana is of average height with a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical checklists.
Has a lucky wrench that she polishes before every race.
Insists on drinking a cup of strong black coffee every morning at precisely 7:00 AM.
